catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: Trade prices incl. VAT. Delivery: {{zones}}.
catalogue.search: Search by product, brand or SKU
catalogue.empty_body: Add products one by one or import your whole catalogue as a CSV.
catalogue.confirm_delete: Delete “{{name}}” from the catalogue? Past orders stay as they are.

form.name: Product name
form.sku_help: Used to update the product during a CSV import.
form.lead_time_help: Leave empty to use your company profile's shipping time.
form.photos_help: Up to 6 photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, 5 MB max). Without a photo, a text card is shown.
form.own_zones_help: For example, furniture you only deliver nearby. Otherwise, your company profile's zones apply.

invalid.name: The name must be at least 2 characters.
invalid.price: Enter a valid price incl. VAT.
invalid.minOrderQty: The minimum order must be a whole number of at least 1.
invalid.stock: Stock must be a positive whole number.
invalid.leadTimeDays: Shipping time must be between 0 and 60 days.
invalid.photos: One of the photos isn't valid (6 max).

import.title: Import a CSV catalogue
import.intro: One row per product, first row = column names, semicolon or comma separator, UTF-8 encoding. Products whose SKU already exists are updated; the others are added.

columns.prix_ttc: Trade price incl. VAT in DA (required)
columns.delai_jours: Shipping time in days (empty = your profile's shipping time)
columns.zones: Wilayas separated by | or ALL (empty = your profile's zones)

fields.header: missing header (nom, categorie and prix_ttc are required)
fields.name: missing name

import.error: The file couldn't be read. Check its format.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle_supplier: Accept, ship and track your orders. You're paid once the salon has received the order.
orders.empty_supplier_body: Orders paid by salons show up here.
orders.empty_salon_body: Your orders from suppliers will show up here.

order.title: Order {{number}}
order.carrier_placeholder: Yalidine, ZR Express, our own driver…
order.ship_body: The salon is notified by email with these details.
order.refuse_body: The salon gets a full refund ({{amount}}) and the quantities go back into your stock.
order.ship_deadline_supplier: Ship by {{date}}. After that, the salon is refunded automatically.
order.auto_release_supplier: If the salon doesn't respond, you'll be paid on {{date}}.
order.disputed_supplier: The funds are on hold. Reply to the salon in the messages, then the Saloneo team decides (full refund, partial refund or payout).
order.disputed_salon: The funds are on hold. The Saloneo team is looking into it and may message you here.
order.refund_pending: The bank is processing the refund.
order.released_supplier: This payment is yours and will be included in the next payout.
order.paid_out: The payment for this order has been paid out to you.
order.cancel_confirm: Cancel the order? The supplier hasn't accepted it yet: {{amount}} will be refunded to your card.
order.received_confirm: Do you confirm you received the full order as ordered? The payment will be released to {{supplier}}.
order.report_body: The funds stay on hold until the Saloneo team decides. The supplier is notified.
order.report_placeholder: Parcel not received, damaged products, missing items…
order.pending_payment: Order awaiting payment. It expires on {{date}} if not paid.
order.payment_failed: The payment didn't go through: {{message}}. You can try again.
order.paid_salon: Payment received. {{supplier}} must accept and ship the order by {{date}}, otherwise you're refunded automatically.
order.accepted_salon: The supplier is preparing your order (ships by {{date}}).
order.shipped_salon: Your order is on its way. When it arrives, confirm it or report a problem. If you do nothing, the supplier is paid on {{date}}.
order.partial_salon: Partial refund of {{amount}} to the card used.

messages.title: Messages
messages.supplier_hint: The salon gets your messages by email.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Saloneo collects each order and pays it out to you after receipt, minus the {{commission}}% commission.
payments.payout_description: The account Saloneo sends your transfers to.
payments.rib_missing: Add your RIB to receive payouts.
payments.no_payouts_body: Delivered orders are paid out by bank transfer, with a confirmation email.
payments.invoices_description: One printable statement per delivered order, with the Saloneo commission itemised.

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Your profile, visible to salons, and your delivery rules.
company.card_description: Salons see your name, wilaya, description and phone number. Your NIF and RC are only visible to Saloneo.
company.email_note: Login and notification email: {{email}}. To change it, contact Saloneo.
company.shipping_description: You deliver with your own carrier. These rules apply to every order.
company.leadTimeDays_help: Shown to salons. Can be changed per product.

invoice.title: Sales statement
invoice.total_ttc: Total incl. VAT paid by the salon
invoice.note: Payment collected by Saloneo on behalf of the supplier (CIB / Edahabia via SATIM) and paid out by bank transfer after delivery.

browse.search: Search for a product: shampoo, gloves, nail polish…
browse.payments_soon: Online payment for orders is coming soon. You can already browse catalogues and fill your carts.
browse.no_suppliers_wilaya: No supplier delivers to {{wilaya}} yet. Try “All wilayas”.
browse.how_it_works: You pay by CIB or Edahabia card. Saloneo holds the payment until you confirm receipt; if something goes wrong, report it and the funds stay on hold.

product.not_delivered_body: This product isn't delivered to the selected wilaya.

cart.empty_body: Add products from the suppliers' catalogues.
cart.one_order_per_supplier: One cart per supplier: each cart becomes one order and one payment.
cart.subtotal_hint: Items: {{amount}} (delivery calculated at the next step)

problem.UNAVAILABLE: This product is no longer available

checkout.title: Order from {{supplier}}
checkout.name: Salon
checkout.escrow: Saloneo collects the payment and only releases it to the supplier once you confirm receipt. If it isn't shipped in time, you're refunded automatically.
checkout.cards: CIB or Edahabia card · secure payment by SATIM
checkout.cart_changed: Your cart has changed (stock, price or availability). Check the summary.
checkout.error: The payment couldn't be started. Try again in a moment.

stock.title: Add to stock
stock.intro: For each item, choose which product in your stock to top up, and by how much. Your choice is remembered for future orders.
stock.skipped: This item won't be added to stock.
stock.qty_help: The quantity is in your stock's unit (a carton of 12 bottles = 12 units, or 12,000 ml).

return.paid_body: {{supplier}} has been notified and will prepare your order. You'll get a confirmation email.
return.failed_body: You haven't been charged. You can try again.
return.verify_failed: We can't verify the payment right now. Reload the page in a few moments.
return.support: If you were charged without a confirmation, contact Saloneo with your order number.

apply.title: Sell to beauty salons across Algeria
apply.subtitle: Offer your professional catalogue to Saloneo salons. You deliver, Saloneo collects the payment and pays you.
apply.step1_body: Your company, NIF, RC and RIB. Approval within 2 business days.
apply.step2_body: Product by product or by importing a CSV file. Trade prices incl. VAT, stock, delivery zones.
apply.step3_body: The salon pays by CIB / Edahabia card. You accept, ship with your carrier and add the tracking number.
apply.step4_body: As soon as the salon confirms receipt (or after 7 days), the amount goes to your balance and is transferred to you.
apply.fees: Free to join. Saloneo takes a commission on each delivered order (8% by default), nothing else.
apply.payout_help: The account Saloneo transfers your delivered-order earnings to.
apply.accept: I certify that this information is accurate and I agree that Saloneo collects salon payments on my behalf and pays them to me, minus commission.
apply.email_taken: An account already exists with this email. Log in instead.
apply.error: Your application couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.

invalid.rib: Invalid RIB: 20 digits (a CCP RIP starts with 00799999).

admin.payments_disabled: Online payment for orders is turned off (MARKETPLACE_PAYMENTS_ENABLED). Salons can see catalogues but can't pay.
admin.escrow_hint: Paid by salons, not yet released
admin.settings_description: Apply to new orders; an order's commission is set when it's created.
admin.commissionPercent_help: Percentage of the order total incl. VAT. Can be changed per supplier.
admin.shipDeadlineDays_help: After payment. Past this deadline, the salon is refunded automatically.
admin.autoReleaseDays_help: After shipping, if the salon neither confirms nor reports anything. Reminders sent on day 3 and the day before.
admin.applications_description: Check the NIF and RC before approving: only approved suppliers are visible to salons.
admin.invite_body: The account is created already approved; the supplier gets a link to set their password, then completes their profile and catalogue.
admin.approved: {{name}} is approved and visible to salons.
admin.partial_split: The salon gets back {{refund}}, the supplier keeps {{kept}} (commission deducted from that share).

decision_confirm.partial: Refund {{amount}} to the salon and pay the rest to the supplier?
decision_confirm.release: Pay {{amount}} to the supplier (minus commission) and close the dispute?

admin.mark_refunded_confirm: Confirm the salon was refunded another way?
admin.manual_note: Refunded manually by the Saloneo team
admin.balances_description: Available = delivered orders, minus commission, minus payouts already made.
admin.payout_email_note: The supplier gets a payout confirmation email.
admin.exceeds: The amount exceeds the available balance.
